what: Helper exit status is always 0 when the while loop exhausts (last command is attempt=$((attempt+1)))
scenario_or_breakage: On exhaustion the function still returns 0; if a call site uses if retry_pr_info_unknown_recovery N or relies on $? instead of re-reading MERGE_STATE, a persistent UNKNOWN/empty state could fall through without setting MERGE_RESULT=error
suggested_fix: Keep the planned MERGE_STATE re-check at both call sites; add a one-line helper comment that $? must not be used (only MERGE_STATE), or end the helper with explicit return 1 after the loop
